title: 검사복무평정규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 5 (Evaluation Methods)
(1) Service evaluators shall conduct evaluations objectively so as to ensure reliability and fairness. In such cases, service evaluators under the subparagraphs of Article 3 (1) (hereinafter referred to as "service evaluators") shall respect opinions collected at evaluation meetings under Article 5-2 when conducting service evaluations. [Amended on November 30, 2018.]
(2) Service evaluators shall comprehensively assess the work attitude of the prosecutor being evaluated (including humility, attentive listening, kindness, and consideration toward the public, and examples of exemplary conduct), specific performance achievements, capabilities, etc. [Amended on February 20, 2020.]
(3) To undergo a service evaluation, a prosecutor shall prepare a statement of his or her work performance and report it to the superior referred to in the subparagraphs of Article 3 (1).
